properties.name: The half-ideas get a way to be joined
properties.rationale:
Closes the three gaps measured against half-idea linking on 2026-08-25, on Anthony's word, queued behind the store question exactly as he asked.

⭐ THE INTERESTING PART IS THAT ALL THREE LEGS ALREADY EXISTED. The vocabulary (`review_relations`), the structural home (`no_relation_note`), the detector (`unreviewed_ideas`) and the instruction (brainstorm step 4) were all fitted, and 110 of 183 ideas still reached nothing. The three-legs model predicts that should work. What it does not cover is that an instruction can be correct AT ONE MOMENT and useless at another: "judge the near-matches you already have" is right when a duplicate-guard search is in hand, and gives a session working the BACKLOG nothing, because the idea was written weeks ago.

⭐ AN ASSERTED EDGE OUTRANKS A VOCABULARY COINCIDENCE CATEGORICALLY, NOT BY A MULTIPLIER. The first cut weighted structure 3x; a test showed four shared words beating it. The fix was to make structural presence the primary sort key rather than to raise the constant until the example passed — a weight chosen to make one case come out right is taste presented as arithmetic, and this project already ranks asserted above inferred elsewhere (HEAL merges only on a human-drawn DUPLICATES edge).

🛑 THE MODULE BOUNDARY WAS SET BY THE GRAPH, NOT BY PREFERENCE. `relate.rs` states in its own docs that it deliberately does not suggest, because a machine proposing edges there would manufacture the false neighbours the brainstorm skill forbids — while assigning candidate-offering to "the dedup guard's job and the skill's". So the suggester is a separate read-only module and drawing stays a human act.

⚠️ AND IT IS DELIBERATELY NOT BUILT ON `search_design`, the obvious tool, which is gated behind `fulltext` and fails loud without it: a BM25 suggester would be absent from every index-less build and untestable by the core gate that holds 1,486 of the tests.

TWO DEFECTS THE TESTS CAUGHT, both real rather than cosmetic: the background-term filter rejected every term on a small pool (any shared word is 50% of a two-node pool by arithmetic, not by being common), and text could outrank structure.

THE `what_next` HALF IS OPTION E of `dec:idea-should-an-idea-be-linked-to-the-intent-that-scopes-it` — fix the reader, leave the vocabulary. An idea contradicting an accepted Decision scored +2 and surfaced; one contradicting a Requirement stored the edge and scored ZERO, because the set was built from Decisions alone. The unread case is the more serious one. Requirements settled OUT are excluded: contradicting something already abandoned is not a live tension. The SCOPING half of that decision stays open.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Added `relation_candidates` (read-only, index-free, in its own module), the `link-ideas` skill and command in all three mirrors, and the `what_next` fix that scores an idea contradicting settled intent. Nine tests; one new toolsnap golden; four field terms added to skill_lint's known list.
